back: A sentence form in which the subject receives the action: be + past participle.
notes: The road was repaired (by the council).

back: The doer of the action in a passive sentence, introduced by by.
modal + be + past participle; modal perfect: modal + have been + past participle.
notes: must be done; should have been done

back: is/are being + participle (present); was/were being + participle (past).
has/have been + participle; had been + participle.
When the doer is unknown, obvious, unimportant or people in general.
Intransitive verbs (no object): die, arrive, happen, sleep, fall.
Passive suits reports, minutes and science; active suits stories and friendly letters.
Object pronouns become subject pronouns: us → we, them → they, him → he, me → I.
notes: They praised us → We were praised.
